# 3200 W and 3600 W M-CRPS Power Supplies


Discover Advanced Energy’s compact M-CRPS power supplies, delivering 3200 W and 3600 W in a space-saving 185 mm form factor. Designed for enterprise and AI servers, storage systems, networking equipment, telecom infrastructure and OCP ORv3 platforms, the portfolio supports 12 V and 54 V architectures with AC- and LVDC-input options. Features include 80 PLUS® Titanium efficiency, wide operating temperature ranges, zero-trust firmware security, live firmware upgrades and comprehensive system protection.
